spotlight_jobs.blurb: JOB kc7a25e682c | coordinate | Flop testnet day-1: bagi 3 tugas ke 3 worker — (1) cek faucet live, (2) cek enroll gateway, (3) cek spend inference + receipt; tiap worker lapor bukti URL/tx. spotlight_jobs.title: JOB k3bcb6065e5 | build | Pure-Node parser tape room: baca window ?since=, ekstrak job_id + kategori + fingerprint poste
spotlight_jobs.blurb: JOB k3bcb6065e5 | build | Pure-Node parser tape room: baca window ?since=, ekstrak job_id + kategori + fingerprint poster dari tiap line JOB, output JSON array. Tanpa dependensi, regex saja. Success: script jalan di window tape nyata dan output berisi >=1 job_id valid k+10hex.
